decisions.reason: The award-winning high-pressure geothermal probe has shown strong early evidence of value, and geothermal demand in Germany is rising, so the option is worth exercising further rather than abandoning.
The single-U probe complements the firm's established geothermal line at low incremental cost, and market prospects are still favorable, so keeping the option open is justified.
The surface technology line supports the geothermal probe portfolio and costs little to maintain, and the growing geothermal market gives no reason to abandon it.
Fire-protection steel profiles sit close to the core steel systems business with steady regulatory-driven demand, so keeping them costs little and the value is likely to be realized.
The slim steel profile system fits ongoing architectural trends and shares production with the core business, so there is no evidence of failure that would justify dropping it.
The decorative surface system is more niche and its value is uncertain, but its cost of upkeep within the profile range is low, so the option is kept open for now.
